metadata.title: Opinion: Forget data centers. The next great AI stocks are hiding in plain sight in these four sectors. - MarketWatch

content.text:
Outside the Box
Opinion: Forget data centers. The next great AI stocks are hiding in plain sight in these four sectors.
Stanley Druckenmiller thinks the next big winners will come from applying AI. Here are three companies worth watching.
If you bought artificial-intelligence infrastructure stocks two years ago, you likely made a boatload of money.
The thesis was simple: Big Tech will spend hundreds of billions on GPUs, memory and servers, and those benefiting from that spending will see an earnings boom. That’s exactly what happened, and it’s a key reason stocks like Micron MU, SanDisk SNDK and Dell DELL became huge winners.
